title: Canonical truncation comparison packages and compatibility equations
statement: For triangulated categories with additive integer shifts [def-weil-triangulated-category] and t-structures [def-weil-t-structure], put $H^j_t=\tau_{<j+1}\tau_{\ge j}[j]$ in functor-composition order. Define heartRestriction of $F$ using its specified preservation of the heart. For a functor with specified shift comparison, Comparisons consists of triangulated exactness, t-exactness, heart preservation with additive exact restriction, natural isomorphisms $\tau_{<m+1}F\cong F\tau_{<m+1}$ and $\tau_{\ge m}F\cong F\tau_{\ge m}$ uniquely normalized by the truncation counit and unit, and $H^j_tF\cong FH^j_t$ equal to their composite with the specified shift comparison. CompositeCompatible requires the upper-truncation, lower-truncation and cohomology comparisons for a composite to equal the composites transported through the supplied functor isomorphism. SquareCompatible requires those same three comparison squares to commute through a supplied natural isomorphism $FV\cong UG$. These are the explicit equations, for all integer cutoffs and degrees and every object, rather than assertions of unspecified compatibility.
